name: 13F Consensus Dashboard
description: A read-only dashboard that turns selected managers' reported U.S. long positions into an inspectable view of institutional overlap, concentration and quarter-over-quarter change.
intended_use: Find securities repeatedly held across selected managers
Compare reported position changes across quarters
Choose candidates for deeper company, industry or thesis research
data_sources: arkfunds.io mirror of ARK daily disclosures for the separate weekly context
limitations: 13F filings are delayed after quarter end
13F does not represent a manager's complete portfolio or short positions
Historical disclosure is not a real-time capital-flow or trading signal
public_artifact: Self-contained static HTML. Browser-delivered interface code and displayed data are inspectable.
